Dados: `../data/wdi.csv` via `uv run brviz fetch`. Pares = doadores TD 626 + Coreia/Chéquia + UMC/LAC.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

csv = Path("../data/wdi.csv")
wdi = pd.read_csv(csv)
ppp = wdi[wdi.metric == "gdp_pc_ppp"].copy()
ppp["year"] = ppp["year"].astype(int)
print(ppp.groupby("iso").year.agg(["min", "max", "count"]).sort_index().to_string())
```

```{python}
keep = [
    "BRA",
    "TUR",
    "THA",
    "ZAF",
    "UKR",
    "CHL",
    "MEX",
    "POL",
    "CHN",
    "KOR",
    "UMC",
]
plot = ppp[ppp.iso.isin(keep)].copy()
names = {
    "BRA": "Brasil",
    "TUR": "Turquia",
    "THA": "Tailândia",
    "ZAF": "África do Sul",
    "UKR": "Ucrânia",
    "CHL": "Chile",
    "MEX": "México",
    "POL": "Polônia",
    "CHN": "China",
    "KOR": "Coreia",
    "UMC": "Upper middle income",
}
plot["country"] = plot.iso.map(names)
fig = px.line(
    plot,
    x="year",
    y="value",
    color="country",
    title="GDP per capita PPP (constante 2021 intl $)",
    labels={"year": "Ano", "value": "intl $ 2021", "country": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(legend_title_text="")
fig.update_traces(selector=dict(name="Brasil"), line=dict(width=3))
fig.show()
```

Fonte: World Bank WDI `NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD`. Turquia/Tailândia/Ucrânia/África do Sul = pesos do controle sintético no TD 626 (PIB per capita).
